question: Can the causal LSTM predict pit entry from lap-by-lap race state and telemetry alone, without driver/team/circuit identity and race-constant weather?

rationale.removed_static: Identity of driver, team and circuit is constant for every sample of a driver-race; the test removes this memorization channel.
rationale.removed_numeric: Ambient weather that is almost constant within a race (less than 5% of its train variance is within-race for air/track temperature, humidity and pressure) or ambient wind unrelated to car state; together they act as a race identifier.
rationale.kept_weather_rainfall: Rainfall changes within races (about 60% of its train variance is within-race) and directly triggers tyre changes, so it is kept as race-state information.
